newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Elec to invest in LCD screens.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Elec to invest in LCD screens.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Wednesday it will invest $122 million to develop thin-film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) screens by 2000.
Samsung has already produced a prototype of the world's first 14-inch TFT-LCD monitor to replace conventional cathode ray-type monitors, the company said in a statement.
It weighs three kilograms (6.6 lbs) and is five centimetres (two inches) thick.
The $122 million will be spent in research and development of the screens. The company said it has the capacity to produce 10 million TFT-LCD monitors a year.
